data.title: School entry health exam for Paula on 2 April 2025
data.summary: The public health office (Gesundheitsamt) of Landkreis Beispielstedt invites Maja Musterjohann and her child Paula to the school entry examination on 2 April 2025 at 08:40. The exam is free.
data.explanation: Paula starts school in summer 2025, so the health office invites her to a routine school entry examination (Schuleingangsuntersuchung). Go to room 014 at the Gesundheitsamt, Am Kreishaus 5. Bring the yellow children's check-up booklet, the vaccination record, and glasses or hearing aids if Paula has them. It takes about an hour and costs nothing. If the date doesn't suit you, call 05141 916-530.
